race.comment: HOME SIREN (8) is the horse to beat after resuming with a clear Class 1 win at Port Macquarie, scoring by just over three lengths as the odds-on favourite and taking her 1000m record to two wins from two starts. Her earlier run in the Listed Woodlands Stakes gives her form line more depth than most of these, and she profiles as the runner with the most upside. A TOUCH FROM FAYT (9) has been racing consistently and was beaten just over a length at Port Macquarie, with barrier 1 giving her every chance to hold that form. VEECEE (2) returns from a lengthy break with a solid profile for this grade. He ended last preparation charging home for fourth in a BM82 at Grafton, beaten a long neck by Eagle Hawk Star after covering ground, SAVVYROCKER (7) has not won this season, but her two wins from two starts at this distance keep her in the minor-winning mix if she rebounds from recent sixths.
